root_idea.summary: The root centers on froth, scum, or refuse being cast off or swept away, with a Quranic figurative extension to what is worthless and discarded.
root_idea.development: The concrete image of torrent or cooking-pot scum develops into the evaluation of something as useless because it is carried away or thrown out. Related derived verbs extend the action to emptying, throwing down, and uprooting.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular noun headword جُفَاء.

senses.definition: Froth, foam, or floating refuse cast off by a torrent or a boiling pot.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression فَأَمَّا الزَّبَدُ فَيَذْهَبُ جُفَاءً, it denotes the scum carried away from the water.

senses.definition: Something worthless, useless, or unprofitable, fit to be cast away.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quranic figurative interpretation of جُفَاءً in the construction فَيَذْهَبُ جُفَاءً, by analogy with foam and refuse that are discarded and pass away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cast forth froth, foam, and particles of rubbish or refuse, as a water-filled valley or a boiling pot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use describing the valley or pot as expelling its froth and refuse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sweep scum and rubbish from a valley, or to clear froth from a cooking-pot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive use with the scum or froth as the material removed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn a cooking-pot upside down or incline it and empty out its contents.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction referring to pouring out or overturning the pot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To throw a person or thing down onto the ground, or to prostrate it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive construction with the person or thing as the object thrown down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pull or pluck up, uproot, and throw down or away plants, herbs, or trees; also, to cut a plant or herb.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VIII derived verb with uprooting, discarding, or cutting as its reported uses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The foremost or first contingent of people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as an interpretation of جُفَاءٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ in a tradition; the attribution and reading are disputed, with other transmitters reported to read أَخِفَّاءُ instead.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a cooking-pot, to cast out its foam.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV derived use with the pot as the subject and its foam as what is expelled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land, to become like scum through the departure of its good or produce.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form IV construction describing land whose beneficial substance has gone away.
